title: Pure Mystical Elf
summary: Yugi Muto's classic Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster Normal Monster Mystical Elf paired with her modern retrain, Mystical Elf - White Lightning, and a Level 5+ Normal Monster package. Keeping Dark Magician or Blue-Eyes White Dragon in the GY turns White Lightning into a handtrap monster negate that revives Normal Monsters across both turns.

summary.title: Starters
points: Unexpected Dai Special Summons the original Level 4 Mystical Elf directly from the Deck while you control no monsters, and Rescue Rabbit banishes itself to summon 2 copies of Mystical Elf from the Deck.

Dragon Shrine sends Blue-Eyes White Dragon (a Level 8 Normal Monster) from the Deck to the GY, and Trade-In discards one to draw 2, immediately turning on Mystical Elf - White Lightning in the hand. Illusion of Chaos searches Dark Magician.

summary.title: Opening: Unexpected Dai + Dragon Shrine
steps: Activate Unexpected Dai to Special Summon the original Mystical Elf from the Deck, then activate Piercing the Darkness.
Activate Dragon Shrine to send Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck to the GY (or Trade-In to discard one and draw 2).

Hold Mystical Elf - White Lightning in hand: because a Level 5+ Normal Monster (Blue-Eyes White Dragon) is in your GY and you control Mystical Elf, White Lightning is ready to Special Summon itself on the opponent's turn, negate a monster effect on their field, and revive Blue-Eyes White Dragon.

summary.title: Mystical Elf - White Lightning
summary.text: When an opponent's monster on the field activates its effect while you have a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster in your GY, Mystical Elf - White Lightning Special Summons itself from the hand as a Quick Effect and negates that effect, and if you also control the original Mystical Elf, it Special Summons any Normal Monster from your GY. During the opponent's Battle Phase, White Lightning has a second Quick Effect to revive a Normal Monster from your GY and force all monsters the opponent controls to attack it.

summary.title: Control & Payoff
points: Dark Magician and Blue-Eyes White Dragon are revived from the GY by Mystical Elf - White Lightning on the opponent's turn; under Piercing the Darkness, summoning or reviving a non-Token Normal Monster draws a card and boosts its ATK by an attacking or defending opponent's monster's ATK.

Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians gains Spell Counters from Spells on the field and in the GYs, then removes 3 counters during either Main Phase to revive Mystical Elf - White Lightning or Dark Magician in Defense Position.
Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden converts a single Level 4 Mystical Elf into a Link-1 LIGHT Spellcaster with a downward arrow for Selene.

summary.title: Spells
points: Piercing the Darkness turns every Mystical Elf, Dark Magician, or Blue-Eyes White Dragon summon into a draw and makes your Normal Monsters win almost any battle.
Shield & Sword swaps original ATK and DEF across the field for the turn, turning the 2000 DEF Mystical Elf and White Lightning into 2000 ATK attackers after forcing the opponent's board to battle.

main: Mystical Elf - White Lightning

Signature Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster retrain (800 ATK / 2000 DEF): when an opponent's monster activates its effect while you have a Level 5+ Normal Monster in your GY (Quick Effect), Special Summons itself from your hand, negates that effect, AND revives a Normal Monster from your GY if you control 'Mystical Elf'; during your opponent's Battle Phase (Quick Effect), revives a Normal Monster from your GY and forces all opponent's monsters to attack it!
Mystical Elf

Yugi's classic Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster Normal Monster (800 ATK / 2000 DEF): summoned from the Deck by Unexpected Dai and Rescue Rabbit; controlling her unlocks the bonus Normal Monster revival on Mystical Elf - White Lightning's Quick Effect!
Dark Magician
Level 7 DARK Spellcaster Normal Monster (2500 ATK): searched by Illusion of Chaos or sent to the GY by Foolish Burial, then revived to your field by White Lightning's Quick Effect!
Blue-Eyes White Dragon
Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Normal Monster (3000 ATK): Level 5+ Normal Monster that can be revived from the GY by Mystical Elf - White Lightning during the opponent's Main Phase or Battle Phase.
Dragon Shrine
Sends Blue-Eyes White Dragon (a Level 8 Dragon Normal Monster) from the Deck to the GY, turning on Mystical Elf - White Lightning before you even Normal Summon.
Illusion of Chaos
Searches Dark Magician; on the opponent's turn, returns to the hand to revive Dark Magician from the GY and negate a monster effect.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons the original Mystical Elf directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of the original Mystical Elf from your Deck.
Foolish Burial
Limited. Sends Dark Magician or Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck to the GY for White Lightning.
Piercing the Darkness

Draws 1 card once per turn when you summon Mystical Elf or when Mystical Elf - White Lightning revives Dark Magician/Blue-Eyes White Dragon, and boosts their ATK by the opponent's monster's ATK during battle!
Trade-In
Discards Blue-Eyes White Dragon to draw 2, putting a Level 5+ Normal Monster in the GY for White Lightning.
Shield & Sword
Turns your 2000 DEF Mystical Elf and Mystical Elf - White Lightning into 2000 ATK beatsticks.
